_comment: Arm with: python3 scripts/goal_guard.py --arm <copy>.json after setting deadline_utc.
A goal is TEXT and CLOCKS; the guard runs no commands. Only a clock, the stall fuse or a human ends a run.
goal: 24-hour run over docs/planning for aivm-secrets: land committed, verified progress, not surveys. Work the active queue (docs/planning/aivm-secrets-active-work.md) and the product gates (aivm-secrets-product-roadmap.md) in priority order. STANDING INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE MAINTAINER: (1) Aeneas first. Proofs are about production-called, extracted Rust. Remove assumptions by moving native logic into the extracted core, proving it, and keeping a byte-equality oracle test against the old native code. Never add axioms or premises that restate a conclusion. (2) Every assumption stays enumerated in docs/planning/aivm-secrets-assumptions.json with a class, justification and removal path in aivm-secrets-assumption-roadmap.json (tests/test_assumption_roadmap.py). Exact serde parity (RUST-JSON-01) is deferred by decision; do not prioritize it over planning items. (3) The maintainer will not trust what he cannot understand: keep docs/assurance/native-read-proof-tour.md and the visualizations/ proof scenes current with every theorem you add or change. (4) The native Rust broker must become usable from aivm (../aivm) as a strictly optional, process/wire-only adapter; normal aivm must never require aivm-secrets. Test integration here; keep aivm changes minimal and optional. (5) Open items to advance: NATIVE-SINK-01 / NATIVE-GLUE-01 narrowing; NR-4 then an NR-5 claim-to-evidence matrix (never self-certify NR-5/OUT-5); W8/OUT-2 optional adapter lifecycle and the open negative tests; P2 provider independence (a staged second-provider test exists); OUT-4 scoped write assurance. DISCIPLINE: freeze the tree while dev/verification/system.py runs and run it before committing Rust changes; logical commits with the Co-Authored-By trailer, pushed to origin; journal decisions in dev/journals/claude.md; synthetic credentials only, never live tokens; when blocked on one item, move to the next.
